description: This file defines the ImportAccountViewModel class, which extends AndroidViewModel and manages account import operations for the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It interacts with the NotesRepository to add accounts and exposes a LiveData<ImportStatus> for observing the import process.
external_methods: repo.addAccount(url, username, accountName, capabilities, displayName, callback)
